description: The same first apply, onto a workspace that still has Hive schemas and DBFS mounts.
plan_guard:
This plan contains changes that are hard or impossible to undo:

  - DISABLE legacy access (Hive metastore). ONE-WAY: after 30 days the workspace is Unity Catalog only, permanently.
      module.workspace_settings.databricks_disable_legacy_access_setting.this[0]
preflight:
ok: signed in as the pipeline, a workspace admin
ok: metastore sandbox_canadacentral
ok: account group ss1-cd-users (users)
ok: account group ss1-cd-explorers (explorer)
ok: account group ss1-cd-builders (builder)
ok: no publisher group: skipped (nobody gets it in this workspace)
ok: account group ss1_platform_admins (platform_admins)
warning: the Git allowlist (settings.git.allowed_urls in config/defaults/settings.yaml) still has the placeholder https://github.com/<org>/: replace it with your organization's URL
warning: the baseline disables legacy access, which becomes permanent after 30 days, and this workspace still has Hive metastore schemas: finance_raw, hr_staging, sales; DBFS mounts: /mnt/landing, /mnt/archive. Migrate them first, or set disable_legacy_access, disable_dbfs_root_and_mounts and enforce_user_isolation to null under settings: in its file (config/workspaces/<name>.yaml)
